message:
Let me look at the padded version (line 713+) more carefully. This is used for the second and third test cases in the fuzz target. The key issue is in the first `while(true)` loop:

```cpp
uint64_t chunk;
std::memcpy(&chunk, it, 8);
```

This reads 8 bytes from `it` without checking if `it + 8 <= end`. But since the buffer is padded, `end` is set to `buffer.size() - padding_bytes`, so there should be `padding_bytes` of padding after `end`. Let me check what `padding_bytes` is:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/glaze && grep -rn "constexpr.*padding_bytes\|padding_bytes =" include/glaze/ | head -10</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
